We have 2 pages, but the preview shows only the beginning and cuts off at "Ov" for The House of Hades. To keep momentum, let's parse what's currently in memory from this text preview and compute a preliminary count of Rick Riordan books not on shelves. We can revisit the second page if needed afterward.

history.name: CSVHandling_Expert
history.content:
I'll parse the current text content. Records appear in 5-line blocks: Title, Author, Publisher, Genre, Status. The preview is likely clipped mid-record at "Ov" for Overdue, so that last entry may be incomplete; I'll parse only complete 5-line blocks.

```python
import pandas as pd

# Use the same 'text' variable from the prior extraction step.
lines = [ln.strip() for ln in text.split('\n') if ln.strip()]

# Identify indices where a Rick Riordan author line appears; we'll reconstruct records by 5-line chunks preceding and following.
# Simpler approach: chunk the entire sequence into 5-line blocks after skipping headers and category labels.
headers = {"Scribe County Public Library", "Title", "Author", "Publisher", "Genre", "Status", "Books", "Young Children's", "Middle Grade", "Young Adult"}
content_lines = [ln for ln in lines if ln not in headers]

records = []
for i in range(0, len(content_lines), 5):
    block = content_lines[i:i+5]
    if len(block) == 5:
        records.append(block)

df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=["Title","Author","Publisher","Genre","Status"])
riordan = df[df["Author"].str.lower() == "rick riordan"]
not_on_shelves = riordan[riordan["Status"].str.lower().isin(["checked out","overdue"])]

print("Count not on shelves:", len(not_on_shelves))
print(not_on_shelves[["Title","Status"]])
```
